messages:
maria: FYI I flipped the egress hardening rule in eu-west canary to default-deny for ephemeral ports. Seeing some GPU nodes fail onboarding immediately. Putting thread here.

raj: Ugh, same in staging — nodes stuck at 'awaiting-keystore' during boot.

emily: Logs show repeated KMS AccessDenied on the instance role when calling Decrypt for node key.

carla: Did the keystore role boundary change land with the firewall rollout? I thought those were decoupled.

ops-bot: deploy-bot applied firewall-rule eu-west/deny-ephemeral-2026-03-21 by @maria :white_check_mark:

maria: I rolled it as part of the compliance sprint — audit asked for no unconstrained ephemeral egress. I didn't anticipate keystore traffic relying on those ephemeral ports. My bad.

samir: Quick mitigation: can we add a narrow egress allow to the keystore CIDR (10.200.32.0/26) on the ephemeral port range and re-run onboarding? Minimal blast radius.

raj: +1 to narrowly allow keystore IPs. But we should also validate the node IAM role path — some nodes are using a fallback STS endpoint on an alternate port.

emily: Repro steps I used: captured init logs ->
```
[init] fetching keystore config from s3://infra-keystore-config/eu-west
kms.Decrypt error=AccessDenied key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:alias/infra-keystore
attempting fallback to privatelink://keystore-eu-west:8443
connect ECONNREFUSED
```
That fallback to port 8443 is what the firewall blocked.

carla: Twofold fix: (1) short-term add egress allow for privatelink IPs + port 8443, (2) longer-term make keystore reachable on 443 or use VPC endpoints so no ephemeral rules needed.

maria: I'll open a quick firewall rollback exception to get onboarding unstuck, but we need to track cost and security tradeoffs. We can't leave wide ephemeral allow forever. :rotating_light:

samir: Agreed. Also need an audit entry that documents the exception window and which pools were affected (gpu-warm and gpu-prod-canary). I can draft the entry.

ops-bot: incident-tracker created page infra/egress-exception-eu-west-1751239999 by @maria

raj: Heads-up on cost: if we keep the privatelink fallback, traffic might route out of optimized internal paths and add NAT/GW egress charges. Let's estimate before permanent changes.

emily: I'll pull netflow and KMS metrics for the last 24h and post numbers in the incident doc.

maria: Plan: (A) temporary firewall exception to keystore IPs+8443 (15m window), (B) confirm IAM role/keystore policy to avoid AccessDenied, (C) design VPC endpoint or move keystore to 443 for long-term. Anyone object?

carla: No objections, +1. Suggest we also notify security-compliance and include the audit link.

samir: I'll draft the audit note and add estimated cost delta.

maria: Thanks — I'll patch the firewall rule now and ping oncall if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
